prompt.title: A new family member
prompt.passage:
Leo has a new pet. It is a dog. Its name is Sam.
Mum says, "Take good care of Sam."
Sam's paws are dirty, so Leo washes Sam's paws.
At bedtime, Leo brushes his teeth.
Leo says, "We need to keep clean every day."
